name: Diagnosis Priority
citation: HL7 v2.9 Chapter 2C, User-defined Table 0359 - Diagnosis Priority: its Table Metadata says 'the codes are an unbounded list; additional ranked procedures may be signified by incrementing the code value as needed'; CH06 sec 6.5.2.15 DG1-15 (p42) refers to it 'for suggested values' and 'Values 2-99 convey ranked secondary procedures', so the printed rows are not a closed set
